item.title: The Deliver Activity in ITIL 5: A Guide to Value Delivery and User Experience
item.description: Technology only fulfills its purpose when it reaches the user in an efficient and functional way. In ITIL 5, this moment is managed by the Deliver activity.

item.description: In the Industry 5.0 scenario, where agility and Artificial Intelligence are key, how a company reacts to these failures defines its maturity. This is where the Support activity in ITIL Version 5 comes in.

item.title: ITIL 5: How the Product and Service Lifecycle Drives Digital Value
item.description: A banking app is a digital product, but the transfer you make through it is a service. To manage this duality, ITIL 5 introduced an evolved approach: the Product and Service Lifecycle Management (ITIL PSLM).

item.description: The technology market is constantly transforming, shifting from a vision focused solely on infrastructure to an absolute focus on digital products and business results. With ITIL Version 5, this evolution gains a new engine: the Value System (VS).
